Gadaba dummu/dumme is a comparative extension of this regional bone family; final-vowel variation is preserved, and the evidence does not itself establish an immediate Telugu borrowing route. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4772 explicitly gives Gondi markā/marka/maẖka, Konda maRka, Parji medi and Gadaba maygil/mayggā mango. These survey mark-/mahk-/mak-, medi and maige responses match that specific mango family, retaining consonant weakening and final-vowel notation; the distinct southern mā-m family is not substituted. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

The survey kākale/kākali and kākasil/kāgesil eggplant responses preserve that same-language singular/plural family with source vowel and voicing variation; ordinary number morphology is not a separate derivation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2646 gives Kannada cikki/cikke star, Gadaba sukka and Gondi sukkum/huko/hukka/ukkum/ukka/ukam star. Selected cukk-/sukk-/ukk- survey nouns preserve documented sibilant weakening, stem-final vowels and ordinary plural endings. DEDR explicitly marks Tamil cukkai as a Telugu loan; no Tamil response is included in this inherited-family proposal. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
